description: Lists accessible boards with their private boardRef, most recently updated first. A supplied boardRef selects only that board. Account access returns personal boards unless organizationId is specified. Without access, returns guidance, not a claim that an account has no boards. Continue existing work using its original boardRef or owning account. Continue with nextOffset until null, then use get_board for the selected board.

boardRef.description: Private board reference. For a new board generate 32 random bytes, encode as unpadded base64url, and prepend egbr1_. Keep this same value for creation retries and every later board operation. Copy returned references unchanged. Keep it in this conversation or supported private execution state; never put it in logs or source files. A private board link may carry it in its fragment.

limit.description: Maximum boards to return; defaults to 20.

offset.description: Zero-based offset; defaults to 0. Continue with returned nextOffset; null means no further page.

organizationId.description: Organization ID from list_organizations. Omit for personal account boards; guest sessions cannot use organizations.

name: list_boards
title: List boards
